review_text: This Starbucks branch is usually a bit cramped and crowded making it sometimes hard to find an immediate available seat or table to chill, given that it is located in a mall. Overall, good.

Only 2 staff handling the store was not I expected from Starbucks. Spent more time waiting to order than drinking the coffee. The line moved too slowly and the ordering process felt inefficient. Hoping for faster service next time.

One thing about Starbucks is that what every country you are in the coffee is consistent! I typically prefer smaller independent coffee shops, but being at the mall this was our destination. Staff were polite and our coffee, Vanilla Latte and Cafe Mocha, were both good as expected. The place was clean and they do have free WiFi for 60 minutes.

Overall, the experience here was quite fun. I really have nothing to say about the quality of the drink; it was served and tasted the way it should (I meant the drink was French Kiss). It was quite an inconvenience, though, that they got my order wrong (not really a major one, but yeah). The size of the drink I wanted was Grande, but they gave us all Venti ones (I suppose it was also my fault; I talked quite fast, and the room is downright crowded, there are tons of people falling in line behind us, so I understand the pressure, plus there are also thousands of cups right ahead of us in line, so yeah). Another thing is that we told the person in the cashier that the order was to go, but when we looked at the receipt, it said 'for here'. Not really a big deal, but just a heads up for customers about how they deal with hectic schedule.
